A1.justification: Both complete 14-page PDFs describe the same Spiking Point Mamba work. The main text, references, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification, segmentation, pre-training and ablation results in Tables 1–7 and 9–11, alongside qualitative reconstruction results.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experimental results, including the main benchmark evaluations and appendix sampling, neuron and masking analyses.

M1.justification: The HDE algorithm, Spiking Embedding Layer, Spiking Mamba Block and asymmetric SNN–ANN pre-training architecture in Section 4 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use ModelNet40, the same three ScanObjectNN variants, ShapeNetPart and ShapeNet for the same classification, segmentation and pre-training tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1–3 and the ablations, including PointMamba, Spiking Point Transformer and the appendix E-3DSNN comparison in Table 10.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, voting conditions, input sizes, training budgets and model configurations match throughout Section 5 and Appendix Table 8. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The SMB, bidirectional-strategy, HDE and timestep ablations remain identical. Appendices A–D retain the same FPS, neuron, masking and qualitative analyses.

E5.justification: Table 9 retains the same six FPS seed-pair comparisons and mean distances. Neither version reports confidence intervals or significance tests for model accuracy.

E6.justification: All reported numerical entries and qualitative findings match, including 84.2% SPM accuracy on PB-T50-RS in Table 1 and 84.8% instance mIoU in Table 3. Appendix results also remain identical.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(20), the LIF and SSM formulations, and the theoretical energy calculations are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical novelty, contribution, accuracy and energy-efficiency claims for Spiking Point Mamba.

C2.justification: Interpretations of temporal interactions, spike information loss and FPS-stage behavior are unchanged, as is Appendix B's qualification about comparing ILIF with traditional LIF models.

D1.justification: Section 5.1.2 and Appendix C/Table 8 retain identical hyperparameters, augmentations, architecture details and two-RTX-4090 hardware disclosure. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, all 69 numbered reference entries and the positioning relative to prior ANN, SNN and state-space methods are identical.

P1.justification: Only the marginal arXiv identifier and date change from v1, 19 Apr 2025, to v2, 26 Jun 2025. The paper's wording, terminology and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp is slightly repositioned. Figures 1–8, Tables 1–11, their captions and placements, and the main-text and appendix layouts otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The main text and Appendices A–D preserve the same methods, evidence, explanations and reproducibility information. The administrative stamp update and slight repositioning do not meaningfully improve or weaken the paper's overall quality.
